stories.title: Avec son contre-projet sur les loyers, le Conseil fédéral fâche les locataires

en.title: With its counter-proposal on rents, the Federal Council angers tenants
en.summary: The Federal Council rejected a tenant association's initiative for rent protection and proposed an alternative. The counter-proposal dissatisfies both tenants and property owners.

stories.title: A Neuchâtel, le Conseil d’Etat est critiqué pour son manque de vision et sa gestion de crises

en.title: In Neuchâtel, the State Council is criticized for lack of vision and crisis management
en.summary: Multiple cantonal services and institutions have faced prolonged difficulties, prompting deputies across parties to question the government's responses and criticize its long-term strategic direction.

stories.title: Un problème technique interrompt le trafic CFF entre Lausanne et Fribourg

en.title: A technical problem interrupts CFF traffic between Lausanne and Fribourg
en.summary: A technical incident suspended train service between Lausanne and Fribourg starting at 16:30. Replacement buses were deployed but offered insufficient capacity according to CFF.

stories.title: Le trafic ferroviaire interrompu entre Lausanne et Fribourg

en.title: Train traffic interrupted between Lausanne and Fribourg
en.summary: Rail service on the Lausanne-Fribourg line was interrupted due to a short circuit on an overhead contact line, with disruptions expected until approximately 18:00.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Mehrere Tote bei russischem Drohnenangriff auf Kiew

en.title: War in Ukraine - Multiple deaths in Russian drone attack on Kyiv
en.summary: A Russian drone strike in Kyiv killed at least four people according to local authorities.

stories.title: Breel Embolo fehlt der Schweiz in der Nations League

en.title: Breel Embolo unavailable for Switzerland in Nations League
en.summary: Switzerland's football federation has excluded striker Breel Embolo from the current squad after he accepted a penalty order for forged COVID test certificates.

stories.title: Ligue des nations - Nouvelle affaire de faux certificat Covid: Breel Embolo ne rejoindra pas l'équipe de Suisse

en.title: Nations League - New false COVID certificate case: Breel Embolo will not join Swiss team
en.summary: Breel Embolo will be unavailable for Switzerland's first four Nations League matches due to presenting a forged COVID certificate, similar to a previous case involving another player.

stories.title: Zurich Film Festival: Das sind die besten Bilder zum Auftakt

en.title: Zurich Film Festival: The best photos from the opening
en.summary: The Zurich Film Festival opening featured international stars, politicians, and prominent internet personalities walking the red carpet.

stories.title: Le Conseil fédéral propose sa solution contre les loyers abusifs, l'Asloca dénonce "un scandale"

en.title: Federal Council proposes solution against abusive rents, Asloca denounces "a scandal"
en.summary: The Swiss Federal Council rejected a tenant protection initiative on abusive rents and will present an indirect counter-proposal instead. The Swiss Tenants Association, which submitted the initiative, categorically rejected these initial proposals.

stories.title: Jeanne Balibar offre une ode à la Sicile sauvage et un cri de révolte contre notre monde

en.title: Jeanne Balibar offers an ode to wild Sicily and a cry of revolt against our world
en.summary: Actress Jeanne Balibar performs a new monologue titled "En Sicile" at Théâtre Vidy-Lausanne until October 3, adapting Juliette Blamont's narrative as a poetic and fierce contemplation of a threatened living world.

stories.title: Am Zurich Film Festival – Der «Finance Guy» geniesst Promi-Status

en.title: At Zurich Film Festival – The "Finance Guy" enjoys celebrity status
en.summary: Roman P., known as "Finance Guy," received significant attention at the opening of the Zurich Film Festival.

stories.title: La 22e édition du Zurich Film Festival accueille six productions romandes

en.title: The 22nd edition of Zurich Film Festival welcomes six Romandy productions
en.summary: Six productions from the French-speaking region of Switzerland, including five co-produced by RTS, are among nineteen Swiss films shown at the 22nd Zurich Film Festival running until October 4.

stories.title: Zu hohe Rindfleischpreise, veraltete Lokale und kaum Poulet: McDonald’s-Restaurants brauchen Milliardenhilfe

en.title: High beef prices, outdated restaurants and scarce chicken: McDonald's needs billion-dollar aid
en.summary: McDonald's, operating over 46,000 locations globally, faces financial pressure as consumers reduce dining out. The US company's stock price has declined significantly.

stories.title: VIDEO - «NZZ Pro»-Talk: G2 – und wir sehen zu?

en.title: VIDEO - "NZZ Pro" Talk: G2 – and we watch?
en.summary: Peter A. Fischer, Georg Häsler and Matthias Kamp discuss the future of relations between China and the United States.

stories.title: VW muss Millionen Autos wegen drohenden Lenkungsausfalls zurückrufen – auch 50 000 Fahrzeuge in der Schweiz sind betroffen

en.title: VW must recall millions of cars due to imminent steering failure – 50,000 vehicles in Switzerland affected
en.summary: Volkswagen and Audi are recalling multiple vehicle models due to a corroding screw that could cause steering system failure. Switzerland has 50,000 affected vehicles.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN WIRTSCHAFT - Der deutsche Chemiekonzern BASF arbeitet offenbar an einer Übernahme von Konkurrent Evonik

en.title: BUSINESS NEWS - German chemicals group BASF reportedly working on acquisition of competitor Evonik
en.summary: BASF and Evonik, two German chemical companies, are reportedly holding discussions about a possible takeover, according to reports from the Financial Times and Handelsblatt.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Deutscher Politiker fordert harte China-Zölle: «Wir verfüttern den Mittelstand und hoffen, dass wenige Grossunternehmen als Letztes gefressen werden»

en.title: INTERVIEW - German politician calls for tough China tariffs: "We're feeding the middle class to the wolves and hoping a few large corporations are the last to be eaten"
en.summary: A rising CDU talent argues that Europe must adopt protectionist trade policies against Chinese overcapacity to prevent continental deindustrialization.
